senses.definition: To move your body to a rhythm, usually in time with music.
examples: They danced until the band packed up.
She learned to dance the tango in Buenos Aires.

senses.definition: A series of movements performed to music, or a social event where people dance.
examples: The final dance of the evening was a waltz.
There is a village dance every Saturday in summer.

data.note: The pronunciation ˈdɑː.tə is also common in British English.

senses.definition: Facts, measurements, or information, especially when collected for analysis.
examples: The data suggest a slow but steady recovery.
We anonymise all customer data before analysis.
He spent a week cleaning the data before running the model.

senses.definition: To choose something after thinking about the possibilities.
examples: We decided to take the train instead of flying.
She still has not decided which offer to accept.
The committee will decide on Friday.
